customCodeAllowedFor: provider adapters not supplied by upstreams
cross-upstream workflow state and evidence contracts
production module ports with source-level attribution
curated UI engineering references with preserved license notices
notCountedAsIntegration: a source URL without an executable adapter, preset, plugin, attributed port, copied skill, or explicit bounded reference role
policy.copyleftBoundary: AGPL and unverified-license repositories are reference-only and must never be copied into generated proprietary product code.

superpowers.role: canonical implementation, TDD, debugging, and review host

impeccable.role: default rendered UI design critic, audit, hardening, and motion tool

no-slop-ui.role: hard ban list for generic AI glass, gradients, giant radii, dashboard heroes, filler copy, fake metrics, and decorative card grids
no-slop-ui.mode: copy pinned canonical skill and references into every generated project

uizze-anti-slop.role: product-specific design contract and required-state finish gate
uizze-anti-slop.mode: copy pinned anti-ui-slop skill into every generated project

uizze-ui-slop-gate.role: local source-only PR finish gate for inert controls, missing states, token drift, and generic dashboard cues
uizze-ui-slop-gate.mode: GitHub Action pinned by full commit SHA; no screenshot or source upload

praeclarum-ui.role: user mental-model, predictability, control, recovery, and task-completion rules
praeclarum-ui.mode: copy pinned UI.md with a local skill router

frontend-no-slop.role: page-type lenses, forbidden-slop registry, output schemas, and frontend evaluation fixtures

coss-ui.role: Cal.com production component system, composition rules, primitives, and particles
coss-ui.mode: copy only the MIT-licensed apps/ui skill and use the pinned coss registry as the component source; never copy AGPL repository areas

pro-ui-engineering.role: bundled attributed B2C visual-system, component-recipe, and spring-physics reference subset

open-design.role: running design artifact and prototype engine
open-design.fallback: React UX Lab plus pinned anti-slop skills, coss UI, Pro UI Engineering, and Impeccable

onboardjs.role: headless, resumable, analytics-aware onboarding flow engine
onboardjs.mode: pinned source reference plus exact @onboardjs/core and @onboardjs/react package versions

saas-ui-core.role: open-source SaaS component and workflow-pattern reference
saas-ui-core.mode: bounded reference and optional component source; private Pro code is explicitly excluded

midday.role: real commercial-product IA, onboarding, dashboard, settings, empty-state, and feedback-flow reference
midday.mode: reference-only-no-copy because generated proprietary products must not inherit AGPL code

midday-v1.mode: not-integrated: original repository is currently unavailable and forks do not provide a verified license

ui-ux-pro-max.mode: external CLI only after license review

saas-design-codex.role: optional commercial completed-screen and SaaS workflow reference
saas-design-codex.mode: external-reference-only; no private or paid source is bundled

layr.role: optional UX hierarchy, friction, and trust-method reference
layr.mode: external-reference-only until a permissively licensed canonical repository is verified

flows-sh.mode: external-reference-only until a canonical repository and license are verified

openspec.role: living change proposals after the initial approved baseline

gsd-core.role: optional long-horizon fresh-context execution and recovery
gsd-core.activation: only for phases too large for the normal Superpowers small-batch path

ai-saas-starter.role: money-path source port: ledger, idempotency collision checks, single-writer billing, replay and race tests
ai-saas-starter.mode: attributed source-pattern port into Cloudflare modules

open-saas.role: B2C SaaS capability inventory and operational completeness reference
open-saas.mode: reference profile; Wasp runtime is not the default

harness-sdk.role: optional model-agnostic runtime when the generated SaaS itself contains agents

meta-harness.role: outer-loop optimization of bounded harness candidates
meta-harness.activation: only after stable repeated tasks, a search set, a held-out set, and a fixed evaluation budget exist

hermes-agent.mode: optional research backend, never the production self-modification authority

agent-startup-kit.role: previously considered skill-driven SaaS workflow reference

cloudflare-react-template.role: React, Vite, Hono, Workers starter compatibility baseline
